pages.sound.desc.en: Two short recordings from last night.
pages.sound.desc.de: Zwei kurze Aufnahmen von letzter Nacht.

pages.posters.desc.en: Thirty-six hand-drawn posters, one for every night.
pages.posters.desc.de: Sechsunddreißig handgezeichnete Poster, eines für jede Nacht.
pages.posters.desc.tr: Elle çizilmiş otuz altı poster, her geceye bir tane.

friends.desc.en: The nights you kept, your friends' kept nights, who is coming, and a match when you both keep the same one.
friends.desc.de: Die Nächte, die du behalten hast, die deiner Freunde, wer kommt, und ein Match, wenn ihr beide dieselbe behaltet.
friends.desc.tr: Sakladığın geceler, arkadaşlarının sakladıkları, kim geliyor, ve ikiniz de aynı geceyi saklarsanız bir eşleşme.

djs.desc.en: Who is playing: live now, later tonight, this week. Their sets, their photos, their next night.
djs.desc.de: Wer spielt: jetzt live, später heute Nacht, diese Woche. Ihre Sets, ihre Fotos, ihre nächste Nacht.
djs.desc.tr: Kim çalıyor: şu an canlı, bu gece daha geç, bu hafta. Setleri, fotoğrafları, bir sonraki geceleri.

maps.desc.en: Tonight's nights on the city, roughly. Hover a dot to see what is on.
maps.desc.de: Die Nächte von heute auf der Stadt, ungefähr. Fahr über einen Punkt und sieh, was läuft.
maps.desc.tr: Bu gecenin geceleri şehrin üstünde, aşağı yukarı. Ne olduğunu görmek için bir noktanın üzerine gel.

maps.sub.en: the city, roughly. hover a dot.
maps.sub.de: die stadt, ungefähr. fahr über einen punkt.
maps.sub.tr: şehir, aşağı yukarı. bir noktanın üzerine gel.

cards.desc.en: The nights you actually went to, as afterhours cards: the sounds, the conversations, what was said at four in the morning.
cards.desc.de: Die Nächte, in denen du wirklich warst, als afterhours-Karten: die Klänge, die Gespräche, was um vier Uhr morgens gesagt wurde.
cards.desc.tr: Gerçekten gittiğin geceler, afterhours kartları olarak: sesler, sohbetler, sabahın dördünde söylenenler.

help.desc.en: one card, one night · the room · who is coming · the map · who is playing — how afterhours works, and what the web shows.
help.desc.de: eine karte, eine nacht · der raum · wer kommt · die karte · wer spielt — wie afterhours funktioniert und was das web zeigt.
help.desc.tr: tek kart, tek gece · oda · kim geliyor · harita · kim çalıyor — afterhours nasıl işler, web'de ne görünür.

help.deck.text.en: Swipe right to keep it, left and it never comes back. No search, no feed. The deck is in the app; on the web the same nights hang on the wall, soonest first.
help.deck.text.de: Nach rechts wischen heißt behalten, nach links, und sie kommt nie wieder. Keine Suche, kein Feed. Der Stapel ist in der App; im Web hängen dieselben Nächte an der Wand, die nächste zuerst.
help.deck.text.tr: Sağa kaydır, sakla; sola kaydır, bir daha karşına çıkmaz. Arama yok, akış yok. Deste uygulamada; web'de aynı geceler duvarda asılı, en yakını en başta.

help.card.title.en: go, and it becomes a card.
help.card.title.de: geh hin, und sie wird zur karte.

help.card.text.en: Check in at the door. The night turns into an afterhours card, yours to keep — who was there on the front, what the night sounded like on the back.
help.card.text.de: Check an der Tür ein. Die Nacht wird zu einer afterhours-Karte, die dir bleibt — vorne, wer dabei war, hinten, wie die Nacht klang.
help.card.text.tr: Kapıda check-in yap. Gece bir afterhours kartına dönüşür, artık senin — ön yüzünde kimler vardı, arka yüzünde gece nasıl tınladı.

help.room.text.en: Who was there talks there: two lines, a voice note (soon). Then it freezes, forever. Before the night there is beforehours: what people say ahead of it, open to everyone, written with an account.
help.room.text.de: Wer dabei war, redet dort: zwei Zeilen, eine Sprachnachricht (bald). Dann friert er ein, für immer. Vor der Nacht gibt es beforehours: was die Leute vorher sagen, für alle offen, geschrieben mit einem Konto.
help.room.text.tr: Orada olan orada konuşur: iki satır, bir sesli not (yakında). Sonra donar, sonsuza dek. Geceden önce beforehours var: insanların önceden söyledikleri, herkese açık, yazmak için hesap gerekir.

help.who.text.en: Your friends' kept nights, who is coming — i'm in, maybe, not tonight — and a match when you both keep the same one. What you let go is never shown to anyone.
help.who.text.de: Die Nächte, die deine Freunde behalten haben, wer kommt — bin dabei, vielleicht, heute nicht — und ein Match, wenn ihr beide dieselbe behaltet. Was du ziehen lässt, sieht niemand.
help.who.text.tr: Arkadaşlarının sakladığı geceler, kim geliyor — geliyorum, belki, bu gece olmaz — ve ikiniz de aynı geceyi saklarsanız bir eşleşme. Bıraktıkların kimseye gösterilmez.

help.near.title.en: what is near you, right now.
help.near.title.de: was gerade in deiner nähe ist.

help.near.text.en: The map shows the nights around you tonight. Szene nights open their address at check-in.
help.near.text.de: Die Karte zeigt die Nächte um dich herum, heute Nacht. Szene-Nächte geben ihre Adresse beim Einchecken frei.
help.near.text.tr: Harita bu gece çevrendeki geceleri gösterir. Szene geceleri adresini check-in'de açar.

help.djs.text.en: Live now, later tonight, this week. Their sets, their photos, their next night.
help.djs.text.de: Jetzt live, später heute Nacht, diese Woche. Ihre Sets, ihre Fotos, ihre nächste Nacht.
help.djs.text.tr: Şu an canlı, bu gece daha geç, bu hafta. Setleri, fotoğrafları, bir sonraki geceleri.

help.web.text.en: The wall (explore), every night's page with beforehours, your account and its settings, and this page. The deck, the map, yours, the collection and the djs live in the app — get it on google play. A night's web page opens the same night in the app with "open in the app"; a night shared from the app opens its web page.
help.web.text.de: Die Wand (entdecken), die Seite jeder Nacht mit beforehours, dein Konto und seine Einstellungen, und diese Seite. Der Stapel, die Karte, deins, die Sammlung und die DJs leben in der App — jetzt bei google play. Die Webseite einer Nacht öffnet dieselbe Nacht in der App mit „in der app öffnen“; eine aus der App geteilte Nacht öffnet ihre Webseite.
help.web.text.tr: Duvar (keşfet), her gecenin beforehours'lu sayfası, hesabın ve ayarları, bir de bu sayfa. Deste, harita, seninkiler, koleksiyon ve dj'ler uygulamada yaşar — google play'den indir. Bir gecenin web sayfası “uygulamada aç” ile aynı geceyi uygulamada açar; uygulamadan paylaşılan bir gece de kendi web sayfasını açar.

help.wrong.text.en: A night with the wrong date or one that has already happened — write it in beforehours under that night, or send feedback. It gets read.
help.wrong.text.de: Eine Nacht mit falschem Datum oder eine, die schon vorbei ist — schreib es in beforehours unter dieser Nacht, oder schick Feedback. Es wird gelesen.
help.wrong.text.tr: Tarihi yanlış ya da çoktan geçmiş bir gece — o gecenin altına, beforehours'a yaz ya da geri bildirim gönder. Okunuyor.

feedback.desc.en: What is broken, what is missing, what you would rather it did. No account needed.
feedback.desc.de: Was kaputt ist, was fehlt, was es lieber tun sollte. Kein Konto nötig.
feedback.desc.tr: Ne bozuk, ne eksik, nasıl olsa daha iyi olurdu. Hesap gerekmez.

feedback.intro.en: What is broken, what is missing, what you would rather it did. No account needed. It gets read by one person, and that person is building this.
feedback.intro.de: Was kaputt ist, was fehlt, was es lieber tun sollte. Kein Konto nötig. Gelesen wird es von einer Person, und die baut das hier.
feedback.intro.tr: Ne bozuk, ne eksik, nasıl olsa daha iyi olurdu. Hesap gerekmez. Bunu tek bir kişi okuyor, o kişi de burayı yapan kişi.

feedback.message.about.en: Be as specific as you can stand to be — which page, what you did, what happened instead.
feedback.message.about.de: Sei so genau, wie du es aushältst — welche Seite, was du getan hast, was stattdessen passiert ist.
feedback.message.about.tr: Dayanabildiğin kadar ayrıntı ver — hangi sayfa, ne yaptın, onun yerine ne oldu.

feedback.message.placeholder.en: the wall stopped loading on my phone…
feedback.message.placeholder.de: die wand lädt auf meinem handy nicht mehr…

feedback.contact.optional.en: Optional. Leave it out and the message still gets read — there just won't be an answer.
feedback.contact.optional.de: Freiwillig. Lass es weg, und die Nachricht wird trotzdem gelesen — es kommt nur keine Antwort.
feedback.contact.optional.tr: İsteğe bağlı. Boş bırakırsan mesaj yine okunur — sadece bir cevap gelmez.

feedback.contact.signed.en: You are signed in, so we already know where to find you.
feedback.contact.signed.de: Du bist angemeldet, wir wissen also schon, wo wir dich finden.
feedback.contact.signed.tr: Giriş yaptın, yani seni nerede bulacağımızı zaten biliyoruz.

feedback.contact.signed.as.en: You are signed in as {email}, so we already know where to find you.
feedback.contact.signed.as.de: Du bist als {email} angemeldet, wir wissen also schon, wo wir dich finden.
feedback.contact.signed.as.tr: {email} olarak giriş yaptın, yani seni nerede bulacağımızı zaten biliyoruz.

feedback.thanks.text.en: Thank you. Nothing is automated here, so there is no ticket number and no reply from a robot — it lands in a list that gets read.
feedback.thanks.text.de: Danke. Hier ist nichts automatisiert, also gibt es keine Ticketnummer und keine Antwort von einem Roboter — es landet in einer Liste, die gelesen wird.
feedback.thanks.text.tr: Teşekkürler. Burada hiçbir şey otomatik değil; ne bir kayıt numarası var ne de bir robottan cevap — okunan bir listeye düşüyor.

feedback.note.en: A night with the wrong date or a night that already happened is faster to fix from the night itself — write it in beforehours under that night and it shows up next to the night it is about.
feedback.note.de: Eine Nacht mit falschem Datum oder eine, die schon vorbei ist, lässt sich schneller von der Nacht selbst aus richten — schreib es in beforehours unter dieser Nacht, und es steht direkt neben der Nacht, um die es geht.
feedback.note.tr: Tarihi yanlış ya da çoktan geçmiş bir gece, en hızlı gecenin kendi sayfasından düzelir — o gecenin altına, beforehours'a yaz; ilgili gecenin hemen yanında görünür.

feedback.short.en: a few more words, so it can be acted on.
feedback.short.de: noch ein paar worte, damit man etwas damit anfangen kann.
feedback.short.tr: birkaç kelime daha, ki bir şey yapılabilsin.

feedback.off.en: this opens when the backend does.
feedback.off.de: das öffnet, sobald das backend offen ist.

feedback.failed.en: couldn't send it. the words are still here.
feedback.failed.de: konnte nicht gesendet werden. die worte sind noch da.

admin.gate.nobackend.en: no backend configured. fill in config.js first.
admin.gate.nobackend.de: kein backend eingerichtet. erst config.js ausfüllen.

admin.gate.signin.en: sign in with the admin account to continue.
admin.gate.signin.de: melde dich mit dem admin-konto an, um weiterzumachen.
admin.gate.signin.tr: devam etmek için yönetici hesabıyla giriş yap.

admin.gate.notadmin.en: this account isn't an admin. nothing to do here.
admin.gate.notadmin.de: dieses konto ist kein admin. hier gibt es nichts zu tun.
admin.gate.notadmin.tr: bu hesap yönetici değil. burada yapacak bir şey yok.

admin.field.meta.hint.en: shown on screen exactly as typed
admin.field.meta.hint.de: erscheint genau so, wie es getippt wurde

admin.required.en: title, slug and meta are required.
admin.required.de: titel, slug und meta sind pflicht.

admin.delete.confirm.en: delete "{title}" and everything attached to it?
admin.delete.confirm.de: „{title}“ und alles, was daran hängt, löschen?
admin.delete.confirm.tr: "{title}" ve ona bağlı her şey silinsin mi?

admin.poster.nosvg.en: that file has no <svg> in it.

admin.poster.fine.en: looks fine: 2:3 and nothing crosses the frame.
admin.poster.fine.de: sieht gut aus: 2:3 und nichts ragt über den rahmen.
admin.poster.fine.tr: iyi görünüyor: 2:3 ve hiçbir şey çerçeveyi aşmıyor.

admin.uploaded.en: uploaded. the site uses this file now.
admin.uploaded.de: hochgeladen. die seite nutzt jetzt diese datei.
admin.uploaded.tr: yüklendi. site artık bu dosyayı kullanıyor.
